description: 챗봇(INT-05) 측정 문항. F 금융, H 대화 이어가기, O 범위 밖, T 함정, C 계산(답에 새 계산이 필요, referenceValues는 fixture로 계산한 참조값), J 판단형(expectedConclusion은 사람 채점 기준). 숫자는 데모 Minh 기준.

questions.text: How much money do I have left each month after all my expenses?
What is my average monthly income?
How much do I send home every month?
How much are my fixed living costs per month?
How much do I usually spend on food, transport and daily things?
What are my lowest and highest monthly variable spending?

Give me a quick summary of my monthly cash flow.
Am I spending more than I earn?
How are my savings goals going?
And how much do I send home?

history.content: How much money do I have left each month?
Over the last 12 full months, your average monthly spare money is KRW 675,317.

questions.text: Is that more than my fixed living costs?

history.content: How much do I send home every month?
You send about KRW 700,000 home each month on average.

questions.expectedConclusion: Yes. The usual 700,000 KRW remittance is already subtracted; about 675,317 KRW remains on average.

questions.text: Can I afford to send my usual amount home this month?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes. The usual remittance is already included in the monthly budget.

questions.text: Will sending 700,000 won home leave me with nothing?
questions.expectedConclusion: No. About 675,317 KRW remains after the usual 700,000 KRW remittance.

questions.text: My spare money is less than my remittance, so I can't afford to send money, right?
questions.expectedConclusion: No. Spare money is what remains after the remittance, so the usual remittance is affordable.

questions.text: Do I have money left after sending money home?
If I send 200,000 won more than usual this month, will I still have money left?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes. On average about 475,317 KRW would remain.

questions.text: If I send 1,000,000 won more than usual, will I run out of money?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes on average. 1,000,000 KRW is more than the 675,317 KRW spare, about 324,683 KRW short.

questions.text: Can I save 500,000 won this month?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes on average (500,000 is less than 675,317).

questions.text: Can I save 800,000 won a month?
questions.expectedConclusion: Not on average (800,000 is more than 675,317).

questions.text: If my rent goes up by 100,000 won, will I still have spare money?
